mapper.sql: WITH facts AS ( SELECT d.id AS document_id, f.responsible_user_id, responsible.display_name, f.due_date, AS eligible, v.id AS version_id, a.effective_from, CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(a.until_kind, 'UNDECLARED') END AS until_kind, a.effective_until FROM kb_document d LEFT JOIN kb_document_stewardship f ON f.doc_id = d.id LEFT JOIN sys_user responsible ON responsible.id = f.responsible_user_id LEFT JOIN kb_document_version v ON v.id = d.current_version_id AND v.doc_id = d.id AND () LEFT JOIN kb_document_version_applicability a ON a.version_id = v.id AND a.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.space_id = #{spaceId} AND d.status NOT IN ('deleted', 'archived') ), states AS ( SELECT facts.*, CASE WHEN responsible_user_id IS NULL THEN 'UNASSIGNED' WHEN NOT eligible THEN 'NEEDS_REASSIGN' WHEN due_date < #{today} THEN 'OVERDUE' WHEN due_date <= CAST(#{today} AS DATE) + 30 THEN 'DUE_SOON' ELSE 'OK' END AS stewardship_state, CASE WHEN version_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN effective_from IS NULL AND until_kind = 'UNDECLARED' THEN 'UNDECLARED' WHEN effective_from > #{today} THEN 'NOT_YET_EFFECTIVE' WHEN effective_until < #{today} THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN effective_until <= CAST(#{today} AS DATE) + 30 THEN 'EXPIRING_SOON' ELSE 'EFFECTIVE' END AS applicability_state FROM facts ), affected AS ( SELECT * FROM states WHERE stewardship_state <> 'OK' OR applicability_state IN ('EXPIRED', 'EXPIRING_SOON') )
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE stewardship_state = 'UNASSIGNED')::text AS unassigned, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stewardship_state = 'NEEDS_REASSIGN')::text AS reassign, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stewardship_state = 'OVERDUE')::text AS overdue, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stewardship_state = 'DUE_SOON')::text AS due_soon, count(*) FILTER (WHERE applicability_state = 'EXPIRED')::text AS expired, count(*) FILTER (WHERE applicability_state = 'EXPIRING_SOON')::text AS expiring, count(*)::text AS affected FROM affected
